== Card Picture and Subject columns (27 October 2026) ==

The table now has two picture columns:
* '''Card Picture''': the original card face only.
* '''Subject''': a picture of the real person or thing the title scrambles, or an empty cell. Each file page names its source, a Preserved copy and its licence.

Subject pictures added on 27 October 2026:
* Dan Madsen ([[Dams Denna]]): [[:File:Dan Madsen - PR Celebrity.jpg]], a PR Celebrity promotional image (fair use, photographer not named). It also leads [[Dan Madsen]].
* Snuggle Bear ([[Brangus Glee]]): [[:File:Anagram reference - Snuggle Bear in a 1985 Snuggle commercial.jpg]], a frame from a Snuggle commercial that aired on 4 April 1985 (fair use).
* Kenner ([[Rennek]]): [[:File:Anagram reference - Kenner logo.png]], from Wikimedia Commons (public domain text logo).
* Blondie ([[Debnoli]]) and Angel Eyes ([[Gela Yeens]]): frames from MGM's trailer for ''The Good, the Bad and the Ugly'' (fair use).

Still blank, and why:
* People with no photo that can be tied to them for certain: Michael Girard, Eric Olson, Becky Higgerson, Bill Martinson and Jason Winter (only 50-pixel DecipherCon 1999 thumbnails), Bob Madison, Carol Wisely, Claudia Darcy, Curtiss Murphy, John Sarnecki, Jonathan Quesenberry, Keith Skipton, Leslie Burns, Mark Schaffer, Mike Gray, Rob Burns, Sandy Wible, Stacy Mollema. Photos exist of a Curtiss Murphy (games executive) and a Mike Gray (Hasbro game designer), but nothing shows they are the Decipher people, so they are not used.
* Private pets; no published photo of them is known: Raven ([[Blizzard 2]], [[Nevar Yalnal]]) and Jasper ([[Djas Puhr]]).
* Diaogana Dude ([[Niado Duegad]]): no picture of the subject is known.

[[Leesub Sirln]] and [[Imperial Trooper Guard Dainsom]] now have <code>anagram=</code> fields. [[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 17:41, 27 October 2026 (UTC)

== Explanations in the Relation column (27 October 2026) ==

Build notes:
* Every row's Relation cell now opens with its old short label, then says who or what the subject is, how it ties to Decipher, and how the letters map, with a ref on each claim. New refs carry Internet Archive copies checked with <code>ww_strict.py</code> (run on Bill's PC, since archive.org refuses the box).
* "Uses exactly the letters of" means a letter-for-letter count match, checked for every row.
* Blondie ([[Debnoli]]) now uses [[:File:Anagram reference - Blondie in his poncho in The Good, the Bad and the Ugly.jpg]], a 4K frame from Arrow Video's official sizzle reel showing the poncho and cigarillo. The older trailer close-up is no longer used on any page.

Data that may be faulty:
* Snuggle Bear: Wikipedia says the bear was introduced in 1986, but the commercial in the Subject picture aired on 4 April 1985 (see the section above). The Relation cell gives 1986, as Wikipedia does.
* The fan list's spellings don't always match the letters: Leslomy Tacema has one more E than Stacy Mollema; Velken Tezeri has an E where Kevin Reitzel has an I; Bachenhall has an H where Kallenbach has a K; Djas Puhr has D, U and H but no E compared with Jasper; Nabrun Leids is not an exact rearrangement of Braunlich; Pote Snitkin does not have the letters of Keith Skipton (no H, one K, an extra N); Loci Rosen matches Eric Olson, not the list's Olsen; and Niado Duegad matches Dianoga Dude, not the list's Diaogana Dude.

Missing data:
* [[Pote Snitkin]] (Keith Skipton, marked uncertain) and [[Pucumir Thryss]] (Curtiss Murphy, relation "????"): none of the sources found says who they were at Decipher, so those cells only report what the fan list says.
* Stacy Mollema, Claudia Darcy, Bob/Will Madison, Mike Gray, Raven and Jasper: the fan list is the only source found. [[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 18:59, 27 October 2026 (UTC)

Cells linked to pages that already existed: Cheryl to [[Cheryl Kallenbach]] ([[Chyler]]) and Mark McKay to [[Mark Tuttle]] ([[Warrant Officer M'Kae]]).

Titles: Blondie and Angel Eyes are the film characters, not the comic strip or the band, because the fan list's relation for both is "Good, The Bad & Ugly". Raven and Jasper carry "(dog)" and "(cat)" so the plain names stay free.

Preserved copies: the Internet Archive copies of the Collecting Encyclopedia (20261008192828) and of the Wikipedia pages for ''The Good, the Bad and the Ugly'', Man with No Name and Kenner Products are the ones checked in [[#Explanations in the Relation column (27 October 2026)]] above. The fan list and Snuggle copies were checked again for these pages.

Guess: [[Rennek]]'s lore calls him a "Nerf herder", and Kenner ran the Nerf line after Parker Brothers handed it over, so the lore may be a second joke on the toy company.

For the Snuggle Bear date and the Dianoga Dude row, see [[#Explanations in the Relation column (27 October 2026)]] and [[#Niado Duegad row rewritten (27 October 2026)]]. Dianoga Dude has no page of its own, because no real subject behind it is known.
